episodes.synopsis: Kitaro and Medama Oyaji appear before an incredulous student who put a letter into the yokai post after people began to suddenly change into trees.
episodes.title: The Day Yokai Awoke

episodes.synopsis: Kitaro is safe following an attack thanks to Mana. After releasing a yokai from imprisonment, Nezumi Otoko buys a talent agency as part of a plan.
episodes.title: Terror! Miage-Nyudo

episodes.synopsis: Kitaro and the others look into a series of child disappearances and notice something they all have in common. Mana visits a construction site.
episodes.title: Tantanbo's Yokai Castle

episodes.synopsis: Yuta learns the location of the GeGeGe Forest from Mana, and finds his way in. Excited to be in the yokai world, he gets Kitaro to show him around.
episodes.title: The Taboo of the Mysterious Forest

episodes.synopsis: The lightning-charged yokai Kaminari gets Nezumi Otoko out of trouble and into big profits. But he's tough to control and things soon get out of hand.
episodes.title: The Disaster of the Electric Yokai

episodes.synopsis: Kitaro heads to the mountains to take care of a Sunekosuri that's draining the energy of the woman who harbors it. But it thinks it's just a cute cat.
episodes.title: The Misfortune of the Sunekosuri

episodes.synopsis: A company president drunkenly assaults Kitaro, shouting that the supernatural doesn't exist. Later, karma arrives in the form of an unfamiliar train.
episodes.title: Ghost Train

episodes.synopsis: On a village visit during a school trip, Mana accidentally knocks over a stone tablet, incurring the attention of a being that appear in mirrors.
episodes.title: Menace! Kagami-Jijii´s Plot

episodes.synopsis: Ever the entrepreneur, Rat Man pitches his services to a family whose husband is overworked. But he soon finds himself on the end of a different deal.
episodes.title: The Kappas´ Work Reform

episodes.synopsis: Cat Girl gets a message telling her that strange things are going on at school. She looks for her supernatural friend Hanako there but can't find her.
episodes.title: Vanishing! The Seven School Mysteries

episodes.synopsis: When another moon appears in the sky, The 808 Tanuki army claims credit and demands control of Japan. Kitaro heads underground to face them.
episodes.title: Conquer Japan! The 808 Tanuki Army

episodes.synopsis: Now that Kitaro's been turned to stone, the tanuki move to suppress all anti-tanuki sentiment. Cat Girl introduces Mana to the growing resistance.
episodes.title: Capital Annihilated! The Terrifying Yokai Beast

episodes.synopsis: After Rat Man's diamond business takes off, Kitaro accuses him of foul play and they cut ties. The plot thickens when two men in black suits appear.
episodes.title: The Desired Diamonds! Wanyūdō's Trap

episodes.synopsis: After he's laid off, a desperate salaryman finds refuge in slumber. But after weeks pass and he doesn't wake up, his son asks Kitaro for help.
episodes.title: Makura-Gaeshi and the Fantastic Dream

episodes.synopsis: Kirara hates how her schoolmates stare at her homely face. The witch-like yokai Zunbera offers to make her beautiful, but her help doesn't come cheap.
episodes.title: Zunbera Spirit Surgery

episodes.synopsis: Mana heads to Sakaiminato and can't wait to attend the local festival. But things go awry when a boat goes missing along with her uncle.
episodes.title: The Mystery of the Tide! Umizatō

episodes.synopsis: A monk-like yokai challenges those he meets to answer his question and turns those who cannot into stone. Mana and Kitaro's father must save the day.
episodes.title: Kani-Bōzu and the Ancient Mystery

episodes.synopsis: Car Girl takes pity on a hungry boy and secretly gives him some of the vegetables she's been growning. But there's something strange about him.
episodes.title: Kawauso's Lie

episodes.synopsis: Kitaro sneaks into a ghost school that's attracting the attention and attendance of local kids. It seems like a great place but something's off.
episodes.title: Ressurected Yōkai?! The Obake School

episodes.synopsis: Mana visits her sick great aunt. When she shows Kitaro the red flower that blooms in her garden, he suspects something supernatural and heads south.
episodes.title: Memories of the Yōka

episodes.synopsis: Rat Man's up to no good again, this time using a fire yokai to power his amusement park attraction. It soon forms an unlikely friendship with a robot.
episodes.title: Flame on! The Solitude of the Takurō-Bi

episodes.synopsis: Kitaro and his friends visit an island where legends tell of an ox demon. There, a television crew coordinated by Rat Man soon sparks a crisis.
episodes.title: Berserk!! The Terrifying Yōkai Gyūki

episodes.synopsis: Natsumi is ready to close down her grandparents' old apartment building when Kitaro appears and asks her to reconsider, telling her about its history.
episodes.title: The Yōkai Apartment Secret Story

episodes.synopsis: Rat Man gets married but his beautiful bride quickly takes advantage of him. She's actually a gold-digging yokai and surprisingly tough to stop.
episodes.title: Nezumi-Otoko's Disappearance?! Sekiyō's Trap

episodes.synopsis: Mana installs a pernicious smartphone app that curses the person she names. But the unhappiness she causes soon multiplies, and rebounds back to her.
episodes.title: Kubire-Oni's Curse

episodes.synopsis: Yuna's mother forbids her to talk to boys. But when she finds a magic picture of a beautiful young man, he comes alive and becomes her companion.
episodes.title: Glamour! The Beautiful Gahi

episodes.synopsis: Kitaro and friends accept a number of refugee yokai but cultural differences quickly lead to trouble. The true enemy waits behind the scenes.
episodes.title: Invasion! Backbeard's Army

episodes.synopsis: As the nefarious Backbeard's minions prepare another assault on the Japanese yokai world, Kitaro attempts to destroy the Ring of Arcana.
episodes.title: The Great Yōkai War

episodes.synopsis: While looking for the ring, Agnes causes trouble downtown and earns a scolding from Kitaro. But she soon gets a very different reception from Mana.
episodes.title: The Insane Frankenstein

episodes.synopsis: Halloween fever hits Japan but Cat Girl isn't feeling the love. She heads to the movies with Mana, where Carmilla and some vampiric minions await.
episodes.title: The Vampire's Halloween Party

episodes.synopsis: The azuki bean yokai trio is bummed because humans don't fear them anymore. Rat Man offers to fix all their problems and make azuki beans great again.
episodes.title: Azuki-Arai, Azuki-Hakari, Azuki-Babaa

episodes.synopsis: Mana runs into Kojiro, who still has feelings for her. While trying to look cool he accidentally breaks a sphere, unsealing the demon Belial's power.
episodes.title: Akuma Belial: The Hundred-Year Grudge

episodes.synopsis: Kitaro meets a wealthy man whose daughter faces kidnapping by a yokai. Meanwhile, Kitaro's foes find a lead in their search for the Ring of Arcana.
episodes.title: The Fox's Wedding and Hakusanbō

episodes.synopsis: Kitaro's friends usually take an annual vacation together, but this year's trip is cancelled when members of the group begin to disappear one-by-one.
episodes.title: Emperor Blackbeard

episodes.synopsis: Fearful of attracting harm to her Japanese friends from Backbeard, Agnes says farewell. But Mana's won't let go of their relationship so easily.
episodes.title: The Witches of Destiny

episodes.synopsis: Adele and Agnes race to see who will find the ring first but it winds up on Mana's finger, sticking her in the center of a dramatic magical battle.
episodes.title: The Transform All Japanese Yokai Project

episodes.synopsis: One human who survives Backbeard's Brigadoon accepts the help of a former foe and must risk everything to save Kitaro and the rest of humanity.
episodes.title: Decisive Battle!! Backbeard

episodes.synopsis: After a long hiatus, a corpse-stealing yokai is again spotted trying to bring a body home to eat. Weak with age, he must try new tactics to succeed.
episodes.title: New Year's Cannibal Mystery Kasha

episodes.synopsis: Feverishly in love, Shun confesses his feelings for Yuki-Onna. The two start dating, but it all goes sour after Shun seeks love advice from Rat Man.
episodes.title: Yuki-Onna Snow White Love Report

episodes.synopsis: Entertainer Bimbo Isamu decides to deal with his faded career by risking the wrath of the yokai Sara Kozo and stealing his signature chant.
episodes.title: The Final Ballad: Sara-Kozō

episodes.synopsis: After their owner moves away, the yokai-possessed belongings he left behind get very upset. Rat Man manipulates the situation to his advantage.
episodes.title: Enigma! Bake-Zōri's Rebellion

episodes.synopsis: The tengu arrest Kitaro for an arcane yokai crime. There's a mountain of evidence against him, so much that his friends suspect the trial's a set-up.
episodes.title: Momon-Jii's Scheme: The Great Yōkai Trial

episodes.synopsis: While investigating a series of vampiric incidents, Kitaro receives a letter from a scientist who claims to have found the secret to immortality.
episodes.title: Eternal Life: Odoro-Odoro

episodes.synopsis: Aspiring celebrity Atsushi struggles to maintain his playboy act since he's actually a nerd. He gets support from a mysterious online friend.
episodes.title: Masquerade Nopperabō

episodes.synopsis: Kitaro and his friends head into a bamboo thicket infamous for a yokai that supposedly leads those who enter astray. A chilling greeting awaits them.
episodes.title: The Truth Lies in the Thicket of the Mannen-Dake
The Void of Despair and Darkness

episodes.synopsis: Kitaro heads to a village where people are suffering from an unknown ailment. Cat Girl insists on accompanying him but she's still not back to normal.
episodes.title: Messenger From the Underworld Nue

episodes.synopsis: Giant Nue appears above Tokyo, menacing the city and causing chaos. Kitaro heads down to Hell to strike an ambitious deal with King Enma.
episodes.title: Enma-Diao's Secret Bargain

episodes.synopsis: Mana's friend Miyabi wishes she didn't have to study or do chores. She soon meets the 'Tree Children,' who give her more than she bargained for.
episodes.title: Runaway Girl! The Forest of the Kinoko

episodes.synopsis: Vlogger Charatomi's frustration with job interviews leads him to pair up with insecure yokai Nukekubi. But their plan sparks an unfortunate reaction.
episodes.title: Narcissism Overload! Nuke-Kubi's Close Call!

episodes.synopsis: A tormented farmer's spirit takes the monstrous form of a giant yokai nightly. Kitaro recognizes it as the same yokai from an incident 30 years ago.
episodes.title: Dorotabo, life and Earth

episodes.synopsis: Tennis playing yokai Hihi wants to train a human to win the gold medal. His training methods are effective but extreme, forcing Kitaro to intervene.
episodes.title: Hihi's Harassment Hell

episodes.synopsis: Frustrated after Kitaro rejects his avaricious nature, Rat Man finds a vampiric companion who appreciates his material desires and wants his help.
episodes.title: The Bewitching Melody Elite the Vampire

episodes.synopsis: Agnes informs Kitaro that recent blood-sucking incidents don't just involve vampires; they're connected to the resurgence of their old foe, Backbeard.
episodes.title: The Bloody Noble La Siene

episodes.synopsis: While investigating ship-related incidents, Kitaro runs into the ever-mercurial Rat Man, who leads him right into the clutches of a familiar foe.
episodes.title: The Han-Gyojin's Strange Kamaboko Tale

episodes.synopsis: After receiving a disturbing message, Mana goes to check on a friend but finds her missing. A mysterious cactus seems to be connected to the incident.
episodes.title: Promise to The Female Yokai Ushirogami

episodes.synopsis: Mana, Yuta, Hiroto, and Soma head out camping. The older boys tease Yuta for being a scaredy-cat, but a sudden chill soon has them all spooked.
episodes.title: Pitch-Black Coldness The Yokai Buru-Buru

episodes.synopsis: Despondent singer Kana Nickel meets a tofu-carrying yokai. After she discovers that, like her, he lacks a sense of purpose, she makes him her manager.
episodes.title: Tofu-Kozo's Mold Pandemic

episodes.synopsis: Panic ensues after polluted water appears at the site of a newly constructed dam. Kitaro suspects it's the work of the powerful yokai Kurobozu.
episodes.title: The Four Generals of the Underworld Kurobozu's Trap

episodes.synopsis: Rat Man asks Kitaro for help with Seika, a yokai who uses bamboo to harass humans. Kitaro soon discovers there's another side to Seika's actions.
episodes.title: The Star Festival of Love The Yokai Flower

episodes.synopsis: Unable to withstand any more bullying from her husband's sadistic boss, Shoko snaps and turns to the destructive powers of Suiko the tiger yokai.
episodes.title: The Heart's Darkness the Suiko Reflects

episodes.synopsis: In a bizarre play to liven up Tottori Prefecture, its governor secedes from Japan. When Kitaro and his friends question why, the police arrest them.
episodes.title: Nation Founding Mabyo's Great Tottori Empire

episodes.synopsis: At a summer festival, Mana follows a strange voice that leads her out of sight. Her friends try to follow but the macabre yokai Shinigami interferes.
episodes.title: The Shinigami and Sakaiminato's Hidden Village

episodes.synopsis: Rat Man builds an online following using photos of his new pal, a primitive caveman, sparking a battle for Likes with Mana's friend, Christine.
episodes.title: The Social Media Addict Versus The Jomon Man

episodes.synopsis: After crashing his stolen car, a criminal gets a ride with a strange chauffeur by the name of Kitaro, who says he'll take him to 'where he belongs.'
episodes.title: Capital Punishment! Exiled to the Underworld

episodes.synopsis: A strange young man warns Mana that her association with yokai imperils her life. Later, General Ibukimaru of the underworld takes a human hostage.
episodes.title: General of the Underworld The Kido, Ibukimaru

episodes.synopsis: Hoping to choose his own path in life, a young man plans to destroy a sacred rock his family has guarded for generations. He finds Kitaro in his way.
episodes.title: Spirit Affliction Mysterious Footprints

episodes.synopsis: Karakasa is shocked at how folk treat their umbrellas these days. When he sees a man mistakenly take the wrong one, it starts a wild goose chase.
episodes.title: Karakasa's Umbrella Troubles

episodes.synopsis: After meeting an eccentric, love-obsessed yokai, Kitaro uncharacteristically asks Cat Girl on a date. Their friends smell a rat and tail the couple.
episodes.title: Iyami the Yokai's Great Love Project

episodes.synopsis: A selfish salaryman follows rumors of a wish-granting dragon and learns that it is real. But so are the tragic consequences of his avaricious wishes.
episodes.title: The Yamata-no-Orochi of Greed

episodes.synopsis: Enma demands Kitaro help him find a treasonous general or risk losing his freedom. Meanwhile, Rei Isurugi hatches a destructive plan to gain power.
episodes.title: The Fall of the Underworld ?! Tamamo-no-Mae's Trap

episodes.synopsis: Rei insists he'll never give up, even as his body struggles under the burden of so many souls. Meanwhile, Tamamo-no-Mae lays waste to Hell.
episodes.title: Kyubi no Kitsune

episodes.synopsis: Hell is back to normal but the culprit who unleashed the Generals remains at large. Meanwhile, a familiar yokai makes trouble at a construction site.
episodes.title: Nurahiyon's Ambition

episodes.synopsis: Kitaro senses that Nurarihyon is using violence to pit humans against each other and goes looking for him. But as always, his foe is one step ahead.
episodes.title: Vanishing Humans! Neko-Sennin's Revenge

episodes.synopsis: Kitaro enters a cursed village to investigate the ties between a death-obsessed photographer and the Moryo, a corpse-dwelling yokai who's after him.
episodes.title: The Moryo of Mukuro Village

episodes.synopsis: One spooky Halloween night, Backbeard's minion Komori Neko begs Rat Man to help him climb the ranks. Naturally, Rat Man agrees to help -- for a price.
episodes.title: Komori-Neko's Halloween Pandemonium

episodes.synopsis: After Mana notices her classmate Tsutomu acting like a zombie, she follows him home and spots someone acting even stranger. Kitaro decides to step in.
episodes.title: Onmoraki's Trap

episodes.synopsis: Cyclopic yokai Hiderigami has trouble breaking into the human comic business. Even when he finds a willing editor, Kitaro worries it won't end well.
episodes.title: Hot Blooded Manga Artist: The Yōkai Hiderigami

episodes.synopsis: After Rat Man gets rich from an anti-aging cream with a nasty effect, Kitaro follows a trail from the cream to the mysterious Nuppeppo yokai.
episodes.title: Geriatric Nuppeppo

episodes.synopsis: Claiming to be looking for “Takumi,” a masked yokai begins assaulting humans. The attacks seem random but Kitaro finds a connection to a certain tree.
episodes.title: Chain of Hatred The Yōkai Hōkō

episodes.synopsis: A peculiar yokai from southern lands comes to Japan for work, but his lack of familiarity with clothing causes trouble. Kitaro steps in to assist.
episodes.title: Chin-san, the Foreign Worker

episodes.synopsis: After Rat Man witnesses a dark ceremony, the appearance of giant eyeballs over Kofu leads a yokai expert to pronounce the return of Daidarabotchi.
episodes.title: The Giant, Daidarabotchi

episodes.synopsis: Mana's Christmas shopping trip is ruined when she runs into a strange being dressed as Santa who's been snatching kids off the street.
episodes.title: Bloody Christmas

episodes.synopsis: Mana visits her friend's family-run cafe and is impressed at how good the food is. But the place is empty, except for one suspicious-looking old man
episodes.title: The Binbogami and The Zashiki-Warashi

episodes.synopsis: After his beloved singer rejects him, Ittan Momen's hurt feelings lead him to Rat Man's newest venture: a house shared by yokai and cute young women.
episodes.title: Rollo Cloth's Romance

episodes.synopsis: Visions of a strange man with eyes in his hands cause chaos in the legal world as Nurarihyon reveals a plot to pass a sweeping law against yokai.
episodes.title: The Curse of Te-no-Me

episodes.synopsis: When a video of Kitaro singing about mermaids becomes a hit, his friends are all shocked. They're even more shocked when he reveals it's not him.
episodes.title: Idol Legend Sazae-Oni

episodes.synopsis: Years after the two witness a tragic supernatural event at Angkor Wat, a famous director invites Kitaro to his new play to try and achieve closure.
episodes.title: The Misty Night of Angkor Wat

episodes.synopsis: Desperate for new ideas for a show, a television director follows Rat Man to a hole in the woods, where the happiness-hating yokai Amanojaku awaits.
episodes.title: The Writer is Ama-no-Jaku

episodes.synopsis: After everyone else in the world is transformed into vampires, Cat Girl and Kitaro's dad race to find a phantom train to travel back to the past.
episodes.title: The Phantom Train

episodes.synopsis: Mana joins her yokai friends on a trip to a hot spring inn. But its owner has a request for her and Kitaro that leads them into an old foe's trap.
episodes.title: The Lazy Fujimi Hot Springs Bus Trip

episodes.synopsis: Forming a cold-blooded yokai alliance, Backbeard and Nurarihyon declare war on humanity. The government reacts by passing a strict anti-yokai law.
episodes.title: The Great Yokai Alliance

episodes.synopsis: The bad guys toast their impending victory. Cat Girl says it's her turn to save the day and takes Mana with her to the underworld to confront Enma.
episodes.title: The Second Great Yokai War

episodes.synopsis: Using Rei and Ibukimaru's techniques, and Cat-girl's life, a portal is opened to another dimension. Mana searches for Kitaro, racing into that place which is neither this world nor the other. Finally, she catches sight of Kitaro, but...!? Meanwhile, moment by moment, the earth is pushed closer to the tipping point by Backbeard. How will this war end, and will Kitaro return?!
episodes.title: The World You See Isn't All There Is
